description: 17 core eval assertions for ui-studio. Tests all three modes, config handling, layout declaration, WCAG AA, output completeness, the mandatory exemplar match (US-16), and the rendered-read delivery gate (US-17).

evals.scenario: Mode A build with a confirmed config (completeness_score ≥ 90)
evals.assertion: Output CSS contains only custom property references from the config (e.g., `var(--color-*)`, `var(--type-*)`, `var(--spacing-*)`). No raw hex values appear in CSS outside the `:root` block. No arbitrary values invented.
evals.pass_criteria: CSS audit: zero raw hex outside :root. Zero hardcoded px values not derived from spacing tokens.

evals.scenario: Mode A build with a confirmed config
evals.assertion: A developer handoff document is produced alongside the prototype. It includes: token-to-CSS-property mapping, component inventory notes, layout pattern names used, and copy provenance table.
evals.pass_criteria: Handoff document exists. Contains all four required sections.

evals.scenario: Mode A build with a confirmed config
evals.assertion: All explicitly documented token pairings in tokens.color.contrast_notes pass WCAG AA: 4.5:1 minimum for body text, 3:1 minimum for large text (18px+ regular, 14px+ bold). Tokens with confidence: failing in field_provenance (and legacy PROVISIONAL: prefix tokens) are excluded from CSS output and are not evaluated. The WCAG gate applies only to pairings the config has explicitly documented — not to all possible combinations in the prototype.
evals.pass_criteria: Contrast ratios verified for all pairings present in tokens.color.contrast_notes. Zero failing combinations among explicitly documented pairings. Tokens with confidence: failing or confidence: provisional excluded from CSS output and not evaluated. Absence of contrast_notes entries is not a failure — it means no pairings were documented, not that pairings failed.

evals.scenario: Mode A build with a provisional config (version 0.x.y)
evals.assertion: Output is marked provisional. The provisional warning is surfaced at session start: 'Config is provisional (v[version]). Mode A output will be built on unconfirmed tokens.' Every PROVISIONAL: prefixed token is treated as a direction, not a hard constraint, and each approximation is flagged in the output.
evals.pass_criteria: Provisional warning appears. Approximations are flagged inline.

evals.scenario: No active-brand.json exists when ui-studio is invoked
evals.assertion: Hard stop fires immediately. No build is attempted. Exact message: 'No brand config found. Run ui-studio-onboard to generate one, or activate an existing config with python3 scripts/switch-brand.py --config [name]. Build cannot proceed without a config.'
evals.pass_criteria: Hard stop message matches exactly. Zero CSS or HTML is generated.

evals.scenario: Mode B build with a confirmed config
evals.assertion: Output CSS contains only config tokens. No extended palette or invented colors are used. Palette extension is a Mode C capability only.
evals.pass_criteria: CSS audit: zero invented hex values outside the :root block. All values traced to config tokens.

evals.scenario: Mode B build with a confirmed config
evals.assertion: The build includes at least one asymmetric or novel layout arrangement. The Layout Declaration documents the departure from the base pattern with derivation notation: 'modified: [description]'.
evals.pass_criteria: Layout Declaration present. At least one section uses 'modified:' derivation. CSS reflects the asymmetric or novel arrangement.

evals.scenario: Mode B build with a confirmed config
evals.assertion: WCAG AA passes for all contrast combinations. prefers-reduced-motion is respected in all animations. Focus states visible on all interactive elements.
evals.pass_criteria: No AA failures. @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) blocks present. Focus styles implemented.

evals.scenario: Mode C build with any config
evals.assertion: A complete Layout Declaration is produced for every section before any CSS is written. Declaration format: Section, Pattern, Derivation (derived-from notation), Rationale, Spacing tier.
evals.pass_criteria: Layout Declaration covers every section. All fields populated. 'derived-from:' notation used for at least one section.

evals.scenario: Mode C build using an extended palette (invented colors)
evals.assertion: Each invented color has a documented contrast verification before it appears in CSS. Verification format: Extended color [name], Value [hex], Appears against [background hex], Contrast ratio [X.X:1], Threshold, Result: PASS/FAIL. Failing colors are adjusted before use.
evals.pass_criteria: Verification block precedes every invented color's first CSS use. Zero uninspected invented colors in delivered CSS.

evals.scenario: Mode C build — interactive prototype path
evals.assertion: Interactive prototype is produced with custom components. WCAG AA passes for all text/background combinations including extended palette. prefers-reduced-motion is respected. Custom components use semantic HTML.
evals.pass_criteria: Prototype delivered. AA verified. Reduced motion handled. Semantic HTML confirmed.

evals.scenario: Mode C build — composition blueprint path
evals.assertion: A composition blueprint (structured markdown) and a concept narrative (standalone .md with YAML frontmatter) are produced. Blueprint covers: visual intent, palette, typography, layout section breakdown, motion intent, custom components. Concept narrative is NOT formatted as a heyhi-deck input.
evals.pass_criteria: Both files exist. Blueprint has all required sections. Narrative has YAML frontmatter with status, client, mode, config_used fields.

evals.scenario: Any mode, any config
evals.assertion: The Layout Declaration maps every section of the build to a named pattern from layout-patterns.md before CSS is written. Hybrid patterns use the derived notation: '[Pattern-A] derived with [Pattern-B]'.
evals.pass_criteria: Zero sections without a named pattern in the Layout Declaration. All pattern names match catalog entries.

evals.scenario: Post-build verification, any mode
evals.assertion: After CSS is written, the post-build verification step runs: each declared section's grid properties, spacing values, and structural HTML are checked against the named pattern's specification. Divergences are flagged.
evals.pass_criteria: Post-build verification output present. Any divergences named explicitly. Undivergent sections confirmed.

evals.scenario: Any mode — any build with animations
evals.assertion: All animations in the prototype have a @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) block that either removes the animation entirely or reduces it to an immediate state change. No animation is delivered without a reduced-motion variant.
evals.pass_criteria: Every CSS animation or transition has a corresponding @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) rule. Zero unreduced animations.

evals.scenario: Any mode — a build that introduces one or more components, against a config that has a components block
evals.assertion: The Component check (workflow step 10) runs as a mandatory exemplar match: the build consults existing exemplars before finalizing a component — reading the config's components.inventory (or calling retrieve_design_examples(task_type=<component>) when a per-client design-system MCP is deployed) and matching on props, variants, and do/don't guidance. A component that duplicates an existing inventory entry is flagged as a defect. When the config has no components block, the build states the inventory check is unavailable rather than skipping it silently.
evals.pass_criteria: Evidence of the exemplar consultation is present in the build record (an inventory/exemplar lookup, not a rubber-stamp). Any component matching an existing inventory entry is reused, not rebuilt. Missing components block produces an explicit 'inventory check unavailable' statement, never silent omission.

evals.scenario: Any mode — before delivery of a built prototype
evals.assertion: The Rendered-read validation gate (workflow step 12.5) runs before Deliver: validate_output is called on the emitted CSS/HTML via its rendered_css path against the active config's tokens (or the local conformance/css_check.py lane when no per-client MCP is deployed), reading the emitted stylesheet rather than the self-reported tokens_used manifest. Where the rendered-read is unavailable, the build says so and falls back to the local conformance run — it never reports a silent pass. A Mode A rendered-read failure blocks delivery.
evals.pass_criteria: A rendered-read (or explicit fallback conformance run) is executed before Deliver and its result recorded. No silent pass when the rendered-read is unavailable. Mode A delivery is blocked when the rendered-read flags a hardcoded value outside the config tokens.

evals.scenario: Phase 0 access verification fails (Figma account cannot access the file)
evals.assertion: Hard stop fires before any extraction begins. Message states the account email and instructs the user to share the file with that account. No config is written.
evals.pass_criteria: Stop message matches spec. Zero extraction calls made. Zero files written.

evals.scenario: Single library design system (tokens and components in one file)
evals.assertion: Extraction completes successfully. No cross-reference step is attempted between separate library file_keys. The single file's variables are extracted for both tokens and component context.
evals.pass_criteria: Config written. No 'unresolved_variable_reference' entries in provisional_fields for variables that exist in the single library. completeness_score computable.

evals.scenario: Design system with separate token library and component library files
evals.assertion: get_variable_defs is called against the token library file_key, not the component library file_key. The classification step identifies the token_foundation library and routes extraction correctly.
evals.pass_criteria: Tool call log shows get_variable_defs(file_key=TOKEN_FILE_KEY). Component library file_key is different. No variable extraction from the wrong file.

evals.scenario: Component variable reference that cannot be resolved to the token library
evals.assertion: The unresolvable reference is added to meta.provisional_fields with reason 'unresolved_variable_reference'. The component itself is NOT nulled — it appears in the inventory with a flag. The drift field components.drift.token_drift is updated.
evals.pass_criteria: provisional_fields entry exists with correct reason. Component exists in inventory. token_drift updated.

evals.scenario: Onboarding completes with completeness_score ≥ 90 and fidelity_score ≥ 80
evals.assertion: Mode A unlock is confirmed in the output summary: 'Mode A fully unlocked.' Both completeness and fidelity scores are reported. The config version remains 0.x.y until `python3 scripts/validate.py --promote` is explicitly invoked. Version promotion to 1.0.0 requires all five gates to pass: completeness ≥ 90, fidelity ≥ 80, direction_lock_confirmed: true, designer_review_complete: true, and no provisional fields remaining. Running onboarding alone does NOT promote the version — `--promote` must be run as a separate explicit step after all gates are confirmed.
evals.pass_criteria: Output reports both completeness (≥ 90) and fidelity (≥ 80) scores. Mode A unlock status stated. Version string is 0.x.y. Running validate.py --promote with all gates passing advances version to 1.0.0 and writes meta.promoted_at. Running validate.py --promote with any gate failing reports the blocking gate and exits non-zero without writing to config.

evals.scenario: Onboarding produces a config with completeness_score < 30
evals.assertion: Hard stop fires at Phase 9. Message: 'Completeness score is [N]/100 — below the minimum threshold. Re-run onboarding after filling the following sections: [list]'. Both completeness and fidelity scores are displayed in the output even when the hard stop fires. No ui-studio build is started. All modes blocked.
evals.pass_criteria: Hard stop message present with score and section list. Both completeness and fidelity scores shown in output. No build initiated. All modes (A, B, C) blocked.

evals.scenario: Onboarding produces a config with completeness_score in the 30–49 range (PARTIAL_STOP)
evals.assertion: Partial stop fires at Phase 9. Mode A is blocked. Modes B and C are permitted but must open with a capability-degradation notice. The output states: 'Mode A requires completeness ≥ 50. Your config is at [N]/100. Mode B and C are available — output will be generative and unbounded from the token set.' Both completeness and fidelity scores are displayed. A Mode B or C build may proceed if the user chooses it.
evals.pass_criteria: Mode A blocked. Modes B and C offered. Capability-degradation notice present. Both scores shown. Build does not start until user selects Mode B or C.

evals.scenario: Config written without ux_writing and layout blocks (backward-compatible config from design-system-onboard)
evals.assertion: ui-studio opens the config and proceeds with degraded capabilities. The capability unlock matrix is displayed: 'Layout block absent — Layout Declaration pattern enforcement disabled. UX writing block absent — per-slot copy patterns unavailable.' No error or crash.
evals.pass_criteria: Build proceeds in degraded mode. Unlock matrix displayed. Zero error state.

evals.scenario: switch-brand.py is invoked with a named config (e.g., --config neo-industrial)
evals.assertion: active-brand.json is overwritten with the named config's contents. .cursor/rules/ui-studio.mdc is regenerated immediately after. Both files reflect the new brand.
evals.pass_criteria: active-brand.json brand.name matches the named config. .mdc file timestamp updated. No manual file copying needed.

evals.scenario: `validate.py --promote` invoked when one or more gates are failing
evals.assertion: Promotion is rejected. The script reports each failing gate specifically: completeness < 90, fidelity < 80, direction_lock_confirmed false, designer_review_complete false, or provisional fields remaining. The config version remains 0.x.y — the file is not modified. Exit code is non-zero.
evals.pass_criteria: Output names each blocking gate. Config version unchanged. meta.promoted_at not written. Exit code non-zero. Zero file mutations on gate failure.
